'''Platform 6''' was a platform in the [[Old World]] of [[Zakuul]] that was the location of the [[Platform 6 cantina]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] visited the cantina during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Platform 6 appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
